# Jackson Maroon

> Jackson Maroon is a business analyst at Kearney in New York and an independent AI builder. He graduated from Washington and Lee University with a B.S. in Business Administration and a minor in Data Science.

## Professional background

- Kearney: Business Analyst; previously Summer Business Analyst, June–August 2025.
- University of Pennsylvania: NIH Summer Intern, May–July 2024.
- Washington and Lee Office of Health Promotion: Assistant to Director, September 2023–May 2026.
- Washington and Lee University: Head AI Fellow and Student Consulting Lead; National Merit Scholar.

## Selected work

- [Thinkcell Autopilot / Think-cell for Codex](https://github.com/JacksonMaroon/thinkcell-codex): An independent Codex plugin for creating and updating editable think-cell charts in PowerPoint using existing chart designs and data. The project requires Windows, desktop PowerPoint, and licensed think-cell. See its repository for supported operations and limitations.
